precision.text: Every click becomes a position in PDF points, with guides and snapping for precise alignment.

json.title: Live JSON
json.text: Edit the JSON or the viewer: both stay in sync instantly. Import, copy and download.

templates.title: Reusable templates
templates.text: Save your annotations and apply them to other documents in one click.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.text: Everything happens in your browser. Your PDF is never uploaded to any server.

color.hintPreview: Pick a color, type a HEX or an RGB value. The JSON will always export the color in HEX.
color.hintEdit: Paste an existing HEX or RGB value to reuse exact colors.

custom.hint: Toggle this option to load your own font files from the advanced menu.

custom.description: Upload .ttf, .otf, .woff or .woff2 files to reuse them in your annotations.
custom.empty: You haven't added custom fonts yet.
custom.unsupported: Your browser does not support loading custom fonts.
custom.error: We couldn't load that font file. Try with a different one.

viewer.emptyMessage: Upload a PDF and click anywhere to add annotations. Edit them in the preview before confirming ✅.

items.addAnnotation: Add an annotation on the PDF
items.applyJson: Apply the JSON from the editor
items.selectToggle: Add or remove from the selection
items.selectLasso: Drag on an empty area to select with a box (hold Shift to add)

landing.hint: Many PDFs? Pick several (and their JSON) and batch re-layout opens.

batch.privacy: Everything happens in your browser. Nothing is uploaded to any server.

empty.title: There is no batch yet

resume.title: You have a batch in progress

reject.limit: Batch full or out of space

list.title: Batch · {{count}} PDFs
list.nothingPending: Nothing left to do. Great work!
list.keys: Shortcuts: ↑ ↓ move · Enter open · N next pending

storage.title: Local storage
storage.warn: Space is running low. Remove the PDFs already exported to free it.
storage.block: Storage almost full: no more files can be added.

template.label: Template
template.title: Paste the template
template.paste: Paste the JSON or the Mongo script
template.hint: Plain JSON or something like var pdfTemplate = {…}; works. Only “pages” is used.
template.onlyPages: Only “pages” is used. The rest of the script is ignored.
template.errorHelp: Fix it and it is validated again automatically.
template.noPagesHelp: Check that you copied the whole object. Your text has not been lost.
template.errorItem: This PDF stays as “JSON error” and does not block the rest. You can skip it and come back later.
template.invalidToast: The template is not valid. Check the notice next to the text.

newPdf.label: New PDF
newPdf.title: Replace {{name}}
newPdf.limit: One PDF only · up to {{limit}} MB
newPdf.unreadable: That PDF could not be read. Try another one.
newPdf.pagesDiffer: The original has {{orig}} pages and the new one {{next}}. You can continue.
newPdf.sameSize: Same page size as the original: annotations are placed as they are.
newPdf.scaled: Different size: the annotations were scaled. Check them in the comparison.

size.label: Different page size
size.title: The new PDF is not the same size
size.intro: Choose how to place the annotations. You can adjust them afterwards in the comparison.
size.diff: Difference: {{dw}} pt wide and {{dh}} pt tall.
size.scaleHelp: Multiplies x and y by the ratio between both pages. Keeps the relative position.
size.keepHelp: Leaves x and y alone. Use it if the new content starts from the same origin (bottom left).
size.manualHelp: They start at the original coordinates and you place them in the comparison.
size.applyAll: Use the same option for the next PDFs with this size change

compare.loadFailed: The PDFs could not be opened for comparison. Upload the new PDF again.
compare.misplacedCount: {{count}} misplaced fields (in red). Drag them or use the arrow keys.
compare.dragHint: Drag a field on the new PDF or move it with the arrow keys (Shift = 10 pt).

export.title: Download the batch
export.intro: {{count}} PDFs ready to download. They come as separate files, named like the original.
export.json: Re-laid out JSON for each PDF
export.loose: Names: {name}.json · {name}.pdf. Your browser may ask for permission to download several files.
export.skipped: {{count}} skipped (no template or no new PDF)
export.keepOpen: Keep this tab open until it finishes.

mode.label: Work mode
mode.editorHint: Opens the editor with a single PDF
mode.batchHint: Re-lay out many PDFs with their templates

modes.title: How many PDFs are you working with?
modes.lead: Pick a mode. You can also drop your files and the app picks for you.
modes.note: If you drop files without choosing: 1 PDF opens the Editor; 2 or more PDFs, or any JSON, open Batches.

editor.title: Editor
editor.text: You place fields by hand on a document and fine-tune them with the JSON.
editor.p2: Annotations, JSON and templates saved in the browser
editor.p3: You export the annotated PDF or the JSON

batch.title: Batches
batch.text: You re-lay out many PDFs with templates you already have, one after another.
batch.p1: You upload PDFs and JSON templates at once, as files or pasted
batch.p2: Each template pairs itself with its PDF
batch.p3: You review before and after, and download everything at the end

pdfs.title: PDFs
pdfs.dropText: Up to 50 PDFs, {{limit}} MB each. You can keep adding more.

files.dropText: Accepts .json, .jsonl and .ndjson. A file can hold one template or hundreds: an array, objects in a row or one line per document all work.
files.later: Templates can come later. With the PDFs loaded you can already move on to matching.

paste.label: Paste as many templates as you like, one after another. No array needed.
paste.errorHelp: Templates with errors stay in the box: fix them and add again. Your text is not lost.
paste.note: Only «pages» is used. Everything else is ignored, and $oid, $date and $numberInt are understood.

summary.title: Summary
summary.needPdfs: Load at least one PDF to continue.

match.title: Matching
match.later: You can come back here from the batch list.
match.emptyText: Load your PDFs and templates first.

side.title: How matching works
side.detected: Has a value in {{count}} of {{total}} templates.
side.rules: The exact value is compared first; if none matches, case, accents and the extension are ignored. If it still does not match, the closest one is suggested and never assigned on its own.

unused.title: Templates without a PDF
unused.hint: Drag one onto a PDF row, or use “Assign” to pick it from a list.

assign.title: Assign a template to {{name}}
assign.copyNote: A template that already has a PDF can be reused. It is copied, so the other one does not change.
assign.pagesMatch: The PDF and the template have the same number of pages.
assign.pagesDiffer: The PDF has {{pdf}} pages and the template {{tpl}}.
assign.nothing: Pick a template from the list.

editor.addHint: Adds this PDF to the batch and opens the matching step. Your editor session is kept.

mode.label: Show
mode.dataDisabled: Load test data to enable this view

samples.title: Sample values
samples.description: What each type paints when the field has no «value» and no test data. Keeps a long mapping from breaking the layout.
samples.note: Saved in this browser and shared by all your templates. Shown in the preview and in the exported PDF.

testData.title: Test data
testData.description: Paste a real or mock JSON. Each mapField (holder[0].fullname) is looked up in it and its value is painted.
testData.resolvedHint: Fields without data use their sample value.
testData.shapeError: The test JSON must be an object or a list.
testData.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
testData.readFailed: The file could not be read.
testData.empty: No test data: sample values are used.
